scope: Primary Android15 source explains candidate geometry; it does not replace exact runtime proof
findings: TextView default width mode depends on compat63938206 and ClientFlags core setting; targetSDK35 alone does not establish the test runtime value.
TextView clips at compound-padding content edges and translates by compound-left/extended-top padding.
Plain ALIGN_NORMAL RTL Layout drawing still anchors at paragraph right; bounds-width setter alone is not established as the observed right-edge fix.
Layout standard leading margin subtracts from RTL right or adds to LTR left; one exact uniform full-range span is geometry-only.
computeDrawingBoundingBox omits paragraph-margin offsets. Use an absolute required leading inset and allocate complete references conservatively by ±known inset.
Global drawing shift occurs only when both width-bounds and start-overhang-shift flags are true; candidate explicitly keeps shift false.
